scope: Keep the media usage/archive scanner and public media delivery in agreement with renderer-supported same-origin and verified tenant-alias HTTPS media URLs, without allowing foreign hosts to authorize tenant media.

finding.reproduction: The public renderer accepts absolute HTTPS media URLs for media sources. The usage scanner previously recognized only relative /media/{id} URLs, so an absolute URL could be omitted from usage and archival checks; arbitrary absolute hosts must not confer public access.
finding.fix: For usage/archive and public delivery, compute the allowed origins from the request origin and the site's verified site_domains rows (verified_at is non-null). Accept absolute references only for HTTPS and exact allowed origin; continue accepting safe relative media URLs. Domain query errors fail closed. The same origin set is applied through the nested renderer-specific reference scan.
regressions: Same-origin absolute media URL is reported by the site-scoped usage endpoint.
A verified tenant domain alias is reported by usage and authorizes the matching asset.
Archiving the referenced media remains rejected with HTTP 409.
Published delivery returns the exact matching fixture bytes.
A foreign absolute host does not authorize tenant media and returns HTTP 404.
